content.comment_body: Good morning. I encountered an issue after installing [product_name] on my Mac running version 10.6. Although it appears to start, it doesn't actually open or become usable. Has anyone else experienced this and found a solution? Thanks in advance.
Hello, [product_name] is not compatible with MacOS 10.6. Official support is only provided for MacOS 10.4 with J2SE 1.5.0.

analysis.insight_summary: A user is unable to launch [product_name] on MacOS 10.6, as the application fails to open properly after installation. Another user clarifies that the software only officially supports MacOS 10.4 with J2SE 1.5.0. The main issue highlighted is incompatibility with newer MacOS versions and absence of an informative error message for unsupported systems.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects [product_name] to operate and function as expected on MacOS 10.6 once installed.
